name: qa-testing
description: QA testing process builder based on Google testing standards and OWASP best practices, built on one insight: most teams' testing pain is not how to test but the absence of process - cases written by intuition, progress reported by word of mouth, bugs scattered across chat threads. One command scaffolds the full infrastructure (directories, tracking sheets, document templates, master QA prompt); test cases follow the AAA pattern so any engineer can reproduce them; bugs are filed on a P0-P4 severity scale with numbered reproduction steps; quality gates guard the release line - 100% execution, >=80% pass rate, zero P0s, 90% OWASP coverage. Paste one master prompt and an LLM executes the plan autonomously: auto-resume, auto-tracking, auto bug filing, auto daily/weekly reports, 100x faster than manual. Includes a 5-hour onboarding guide for new QA engineers, handoff-ready docs for outsourced teams, sizing presets from 50-case two-week projects to 500+ case ten-week programs, and 30+ ready-made QA prompts. Scripts are zero-dependency Python, Windows GBK console compatible.

displayDescription.en: QA from zero to release: one-command infrastructure, Google AAA test cases, P0-P4 bug tracking, quality gates guarding every release, plus an AI prompt that runs tests autonomously.
displayDescription.zh: QA从零到发版：一键搭测试基建，AAA标准写用例，P0到P4分级追缺陷，质量门禁卡发版，AI自动跑。
